changes: Routine tennis console messages no longer clutter your server console, warnings and errors are still always shown.
Update lyre_bridge to 2.4.0 or newer so routine console logs are hidden by default and can be turned on per script in the lyre_bridge config.lua.
!! IMPORTANT !! UPDATE lyre_bridge TO 2.3.0 OR NEWER BEFORE INSTALLING THIS VERSION.
The HUD show and hide hooks and the menu background blur are now set once in the lyre_bridge config.lua for every Lyre script.
Values you still set in this script's config.lua keep priority, so your current setup keeps working.
The menu background blur can be turned on or off again (off by default).
!! IMPORTANT !! UPDATE NOW IF YOU ARE RUNNING 1.3.0
Fixed a script error that broke every match on 1.3.0, right from the first serve.
The training AI now serves inside the service box instead of faulting on almost every serve.
Fixed an error that could interrupt joining a court on framework servers.
Rebuilt the 1v1 and 2v2 join screen, which now shows your rank progression.
Match scoring, ball sync and court actions are now validated by the server, so modified clients can no longer forge them.
Config.doubles no longer has rankedEloMode and requireAllReady; every player must now be ready before a match starts.
Make sure to update lyre_bridge alongside this resource. The previous release was broken.
New Lyre Scripts structure: install and start lyre_bridge before this resource.
lyre_bridge is open source and is not included in Granted Assets ZIPs; download it here: https://github.com/lyrescripts/lyre_bridge
Bridge integrations for frameworks, inventories and target systems now live in lyre_bridge.
Release package cleaned and simplified; compare your old config with the new config before updating.
Fix NPC despawn
Fix net detection
Add new configurations for tennis courts
HOTFIX for the last update
Auto leave court when match end
Add spectators ball sync for training and tutorial modes
Fix PvP Ball Sync for spectators
Add PvP Matches Ball Sync
Add config to change UI location
Official project release
